# Future Start Excellence Academy

> Future Start Excellence Academy offers FutureReady online short courses in South Africa — in operations, project management, cost management, entrepreneurship, statistics, supply chain, and business management — plus mentoring and coaching, for unemployed youth, graduates, professionals, and entrepreneurs. Courses are taught live online and integrate AI productivity fundamentals. Courses are currently non-accredited while alignment with the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations (QCTO) is in progress.

Future Start was founded by Ntokozo Mthethwa, an author, mentor, and entrepreneur. Over 300 graduates have been mentored into successful careers.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.futurestart.co.za/): Overview of courses, mentoring & coaching, and the book.
- [Courses](https://www.futurestart.co.za/courses): Full list of standalone (R3,250 each) and combined flagship (R5,500 each) short courses, who should attend, and FAQs.
- [Mentoring & Coaching](https://www.futurestart.co.za/mentoring-coaching): Personalized mentoring and coaching programs.
- [The Book](https://www.futurestart.co.za/book): Conquering Your Years in Tertiary Education (R450).
- [Contact](https://www.futurestart.co.za/contact): Email, WhatsApp, and social contact details.
- [Pricing](https://www.futurestart.co.za/pricing.md): Machine-readable pricing for all courses, the book, and mentoring.
